Louis Mailisand, 17, from Tarpon Springs surfaces with the Cross. It was later determined that two other boys also initially surfaced with the Cross, Jared Alissandratos, 16, from Tarpon Springs and Alexi Lake, 16, from New Port Richey were also determined to have retrieved the Cross. It is the first time in the 106 year history of the Epiphany event that four boys have been honored as having retrieved the Cross.
